text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three years I raced alongside Durandal.
Along with her pride as a knight,
she showed me the ultimate devotion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reward her for all her hard work, today I was
here to execute a certain operation using the
"Hot Springs Voucher" I had obtained earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already made all the arrangements
by coming here directly a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Here's the plan. To give Durandal a chance
to act as a knight, we'll have the hot spring town's locals
come to her with fabricated troubles."

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"So all we have to do is reach out to them?
Understood. For the sake of our precious Umamusume, we will do everything in our power to help!"
choice_data_list: "I'm looking forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, Durandal's strong sense of justice
is sure to drive him to help everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to lavish praise on Durandal for giving her all as a knight, and the mission is complete!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude once more, My Lord.
To think I would be permitted to accompany you on such an important journey.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Accordingly, to ensure my liege can enjoy themselves in peace,
I must provide flawless protection—

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text: Please save me, Sir Knight...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? Is something the matter, my lady?

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text: I take it you are the renowned knight, Sir Durandal. Please lend us your aid!

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
An ancient document passed down at the inn was stolen...
They sent this note saying it would be returned if we follow their instructions—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"'I have taken your treasure into custody. If you wish to have it returned,
you must overcome all trials.'
This is..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but is this some sort of prank?
The phrasing reads almost as if you're toying with us.

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text: That may be true... But I'm just so worried that they might not come back!

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"At that moment, you, who are renowned as a knight,
caught my eye!
I knew you were the only one I could rely on!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wh—?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Renowned as a knight? I wonder
when I managed to earn such high praise.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be because I've held my head high
as a knight and fought hard in the Twinkle Series?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...I want to live up to these expectations!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*
May I have a moment, my Lord?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As a knight, I cannot overlook such evil acts
that threaten the townspeople.
Please, give the order!"
choice_data_list: Show me your strength as a knight!
Show me your strength as a knight!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Leave it to me, my liege!
I will resolve this trouble without fail!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The letter says first,
we must head to the evil Japanese sweets shop."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To think evil has spread its reach into the city itself...!
I cannot let this go unnoticed! To battle!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, fearless Knight.
Let us waste no time—come and face this—

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: A heaping mountain of hot spring manju!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: W-Wow... it looks delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Nay, far from it! Leave it to me, My Liege!
I shall polish off this much in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: I'm not letting you move on until you make a beautiful glass bead!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... That's sneakily time-consuming!
Still, I'll see it through!

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ah, once you're done, let me know so I can put a strap on it for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, overcoming multiple challenges along the way—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have found it, my Liege!!
This is the ancient tome the lady spoke of...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That should put your mind at ease.
Now then, shall we get back to deliveries right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to head back to the inn and lavish praise on her chivalrous deeds, and today's operation will be complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since she loves being praised, she'll surely be delighted—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle!!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Lord!
—My liege, are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you didn't fall...
The footing is quite poor, so please watch your step.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. This much is only natural for a knight.
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that you are weary from all this walking?
Pardon my forwardness, but shall I carry you down the mountain?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her direct gaze holds only pure concern.
Come to think of it, she has always been so straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing what might be a prank threat letter with utter seriousness,
she earnestly tackled tasks that seemed like child's play—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel ashamed for concocting such a clumsy scheme.
Even without all that, she was always a proud knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...My Liege? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see. You put a lot of thought into this
so that I could perform knightly deeds, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Please raise your head. You only
did it out of concern for me, right?
Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was, in truth, a deliberate scheme,
I do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"What matters is to always remain worthy of
being a knight."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"For when I look back upon myself,
to stand proud without shame is my truest desire."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal's gallant figure strikes a chord in my chest.
It is as though I am seeing her true nature as a "knight" with fresh eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while going around thanking everyone
who helped out, we enjoyed the hot spring town—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The whole time I was in the bath, I kept thinking.
About what I truly needed to tell her.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah—you were already out here.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...My Liege? Is everything all right?
choice_data_list: I'm proud of you as a knight.
I am truly proud of you as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! ...Such kind words.
Nothing could be more encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: However, please do not forget.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is only because of you
that I can remain a proud knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That is why—Trainer-dono.
Please allow me to remain by your side, always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where
I felt an irreplaceable bond
with Durandal...
